# Three.js CSS3D periodic table integration

- Upstream: <https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/dev/examples/css3d_periodictable.html>
- Revision: `f9fb68d58e81f3d301ec7f199631a85646c39aca`
- License: MIT; exact license included as `LICENSE-threejs.txt`.
- `UPSTREAM.html` is an exact source copy. The OneWorld version retains the original 118-element data, CSS3D rendering, Trackball controls and four spatial transformations, while adding Chinese controls, keyboard access and a compact detail panel.
